task_completion.description: The agent opens the interface to create a new tiddler.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new tiddler edit draft is visible in the TiddlyWiki story river.

task_completion.description: The tiddler title is set to '$:/custom/ProjectDashboard'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text '$:/custom/ProjectDashboard' is typed into the title input field of the tiddler being edited.
The tag '$:/tags/SideBar' is added to the tags field of the tiddler.

task_completion.description: A 'caption' field is added and set to 'Projects'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the fields section of the tiddler, a field named 'caption' is visible with the value 'Projects'.

task_completion.description: The tiddler body contains a list widget filtering for 'ProjectAlpha' and sorting by title.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tiddler body text contains code similar to '<$list filter="[tag[ProjectAlpha]sort[title]]">' or equivalent TiddlyWiki syntax.

task_completion.description: The 'Projects' tab appears in the sidebar and displays the list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tab labeled 'Projects' is visible in the right-hand sidebar of the TiddlyWiki interface, and clicking it reveals a list of links.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface rather than just modifying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the TiddlyWiki UI elements like the '+' button, tag inputs, and field 'add' buttons.

integrity.description: The agent used a dynamic list widget rather than manually typing out the project links.
integrity.visual_evidence: The tiddler body in edit mode shows a <$list> widget or [list[]] filter syntax rather than a static list of hardcoded tiddler titles.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing sidebar tab.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the creation of a brand new tiddler with the specific title '$:/custom/ProjectDashboard'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required tiddler title is '$:/custom/ProjectDashboard'. It must have the tag '$:/tags/SideBar' and a field named 'caption' with the value 'Projects'. The body must use a filter containing 'tag[ProjectAlpha]' and 'sort[title]'. The final result is successful if a 'Projects' tab appears in the sidebar.
